message.content: Driving from San Francisco to Los Angeles typically takes about **6–7 hours** on average, depending on traffic and weather. The most common route is via I‑5 S, which covers roughly 380–400 miles (≈610–640 km). If you’re traveling during rush hour or heavy holiday periods, expect extra time—sometimes up to 8–9 hours. Using real‑time navigation apps like Google Maps or Waze can give you a more accurate estimate based on current road conditions.

We can provide approximate distance (~383 miles via I-5) and typical drive time ~6 hours under normal traffic conditions. But we might mention variations due to traffic, route choice (I-80 vs I-5), etc. Provide answer. No tool needed.
